name: Saint Dorei Gakuen 3
source:
St. Lilium Academy.
Under the school motto of "Be noble as a lily," this prestigious academy values ​​the independence and self-reliance of its students.
The academy has long produced many outstanding students in the fields of academics, sports, and the arts, but it has a hidden side that must never be revealed.
The Nanjo family.
An illegal continental organisation that engages in various evil deeds, including human trafficking, is said to be controlling the academy from behind the scenes.
The Nishiki family is in conflict with Nanjo.
To the Nishiki family, who have built up strong connections in the political and financial world through the sale of sex slaves, the Nanjo family, who also engages in human trafficking, is a troublesome competitor.
In order to weaken Nanjo's power, Nishiki sends a man as an assassin to St. Lilium Academy.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq42/story.html]the official site[/url]]
translation:
圣百合学院。
在“像百合一样高贵”的校训下，这所著名的学院重视学生的独立和自力更生。
该学院长期以来培养了许多学术、体育、艺术领域的优秀学生，但它也有不为人知的一面。
南条家族。
据说，一个从事人口贩卖等各种邪恶行为的非法大陆组织正在幕后控制着该学院。
锦家与南城之间存在矛盾。
对于通过贩卖性奴隶在政界和金融界建立了牢固关系的锦家族来说，也从事人口贩卖活动的南条家族是一个麻烦的竞争对手。
为了削弱南条的力量，锦派一名男子作为刺客前往圣百合学园。

[翻译自[url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq42/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
